title: Pure narrowband photon-pair generation in a monolithic cavity
summary: Photonic quantum technologies require efficient sources of pure single photons. We present a heralded single-photon source based on spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a monolithic cavity optimized for high spectral and spatial purity. The source heralds single photons at a wavelength of 1540 nm and a spectral bandwidth of 168 MHz, with a maximum heralding efficiency of 70% including all transmission and detection losses, while keeping the multi-photon contamination below 3%.
